proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1351 āryikā lists WPah. ijjī/ij mother and its addendum expressly gives Jaunsari iji and poetic ije. The surveyed iji/ijā forms fit that regional mother series, distinct from mā́tṛ and dāī. Exact survey form eːdʒə is preserved.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 1230 explicitly gives Urdu/Hindi hafta week as Persian hafta, from haft seven. The existing Hindi hafta donor is independently recorded in Liljegren LX000908. These haft-/hapt- and contracted āft- week forms are linked to that whole Hindi word as a provisional regional donor; actual intermediate Indo-Aryan or Persian transmission remains open. Exact survey form hoptə is preserved.
